newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Five Arrows proposes share buy-back.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Five Arrows proposes share buy-back.

text.p: The Five Arrows Fund Australia Ltd said on Friday it plans to buy back of up to 60 percent of its shares, following the recent defeat of a motion to wind up the fund at a recent extraordinary meeting.

Five Arrows said if more than 60 percent of shares on issue are requested to be bought back, the buy-back scheme will not proceed. A second meeting will then be called to consider the voluntary liquidation of the company.
The buy-back offer will be made at a price equivalent to net asset value (NAV) less the costs of implementation of the buy-back, it said.
The shares last traded at A$1.07 by 0230 GMT (1.30 p.m.) on Friday.
Their NAV per share as at January 31 was 113.9 cents cum a 3.5 cents dividend.
